title: Deezer plans a switch to hide AI-generated music
friendlyTitle: Deezer plans a switch to hide AI-made music
summary: Deezer said it is building a toggle, due before the end of 2026, that will remove AI-generated tracks, albums and related artists from search results. The company says more than half of its daily uploads are now AI-generated, averaging about 90,000 tracks a day as of July.
friendlySummary: Deezer says that before the end of 2026, users will be able to hide AI-generated tracks, albums and related artists from search. The company says most of its new daily uploads are already AI-made.
whyItMatters: For listeners who want human-made music, a filter is a stronger control than a label. The switch is not live yet, so the practical change is coming rather than available today.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A hide switch gives listeners more control than a label alone. It is not available yet.
